title: Transfers by size band
statementMd:
Classify transfers (negative amounts, kind `transfer`) as `small` (under 50), `medium` (50 to under 200) or `large`, and count each band.

Expected columns: `band`, `transfers`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT CASE WHEN -amount < 50 THEN 'small' WHEN -amount < 200 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END AS band, COUNT(*) AS transfers FROM transactions WHERE kind = 'transfer' GROUP BY band;
```
